property_summary: For any deposit amount, a re-entrant withdrawal via withdrawAll must revert (the reference keeps credit non-zero during the external call so the re-entrant balance subtraction underflows), whereas the mutant zeroes credit before the call and lets the re-entrant withdrawal succeed.

For any depositor and any positive deposit amount, a withdrawal to a counterparty that re-enters withdrawAll must complete without reverting (checks-effects-interactions makes the re-entrant call a no-op); the buggy version leaves credit non-zero during the payout, so the re-entrant balance subtraction underflows, the inner call reverts, and the outer withdrawal reverts too.
